description: Assign volunteers to a schedule. This REPLACES the schedule's entire roster — send the COMPLETE desired set of contact ids, not a delta (pass an empty array to clear it). Every id must belong to this account or the whole request is rejected with the offending ids named. Does not change occurrences. Requires the `contacts:write` scope.

contact_ids.description: The complete set of volunteer contact ids for this schedule (replaces any existing roster). Empty array clears the roster.

schedule_id.description: The schedule to assign the roster to.

name: assign_contacts_to_schedule
title: Set a schedule's roster
